rules.question: Does a selection change scroll the list, and how far?
rules.decision: D242 and D247 (the user's answers on scrolling, 2026-10-14)

owner_lines.why: scroll_last_row: the one ImGui call that moves a list to its selected row
scroll_block_into_view: the one ImGui call that moves a list to a row opened wider than its Selectable
keep_last_row_in_place: the one ImGui call that puts the selected row back where it sat when every row changes height

rules.note: A click leaves the list where it is, because moving it would put another song under the next click at the same spot. selection_scroll decides from why the selection changed (SelectionSource) and scroll_last_row applies it; row_keeps_place decides when every row changes height and keep_last_row_in_place applies that. A list that scrolls itself any other way is a second answer. The scope is src because a GUI test sets the scroll position by hand to set up its case.
